# COM<tech> — comtechconsulting.dk

## Who

Anders Hybertz is a senior software architect and technical lead based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
COM<tech> is a one-person consultancy by design. Clients work directly with Anders from the first conversation and throughout the engagement.

Anders has three decades of experience in software architecture, technical leadership, and complex technical deliveries across regulated and demanding environments.

## What COM<tech> does

COM<tech> provides senior technical consulting in four main areas:

### Software Architecture & Design
Assessment, design, and hands-on architecture work for greenfield and legacy systems. Sound decisions, clear boundaries, and maintainable solutions built for the long term.

### Cloud & AI Solutions
Azure-native platforms, event-driven systems, containerised workloads, and AI solutions that meet operational, compliance, and delivery realities. Technology applied where it creates value, not for effect.

### Technical Leadership & Delivery
Architecture reviews, mentoring, technical direction, and hands-on support. The aim is a team that can carry the work forward with confidence after the engagement ends.

### Independent Software Auditing & Expert Assessment
Third-party code and architecture audits, SDLC reviews, security assessments, and quality assurance. In 2022, Anders was appointed by Danmarks Domstole (Sø- og Handelsretten) as a court-appointed independent software expert on a five-member panel in a commercial software dispute.

## Industries

Pharmaceutical manufacturing, financial services, insurance, banking, energy and utilities, manufacturing and industrial, telecom and mobile, healthcare and life sciences, public sector.
